user.description:
SailCast turns wind, wave, tide and weather forecasts into safety ratings and sailing windows for your spots, boats and sailors.

**SailCast is advisory.** Official forecasts and warnings come first, and the skipper always decides.

After setup, add your spots, boats and sailors from this integration's page.

data_description.name: For example, Harbor or Lake.
data_description.location: Drop the pin on the water where you sail. The circle sets the area the wind map shows.
data_description.offshore: Wind from these directions blows away from the shore.
data_description.exposed: Directions with open water, where waves can build.
data_description.fetch: Only for rivers and lakes. SailCast measures the open water each way from the map; set this only to override it with one distance.
data_description.notes: Local knowledge for the AI, used in the briefing and when you ask Assist about sailing, such as when the sea breeze fills in or where it gets rough. It never changes a rating.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: SailCast suggests the nearest sources. Tides come from NOAA in the US, the Canadian Hydrographic Service in Canada, Rijkswaterstaat in the Netherlands and Kartverket in Norway, and anywhere from WorldTides if you add its key in SailCast's options. Warnings come from the National Weather Service in the US, Environment and Climate Change Canada, and MeteoAlarm in Europe. Buoys come from NDBC, and airport reports from anywhere.

data_description.tide_station: For tide heights, highs and lows. The ocean model's tide is rough, often an hour or more off near the coast, so it's only there to pick by hand when nothing else covers the spot.
data_description.current_station: For the wind-against-current rule. Pick one only if it's close to where you sail.
data_description.marine_zone: Official warnings, such as a Small Craft Advisory, come from here. On a lake with no marine zone, pick the National Weather Service's alerts at the pin.
data_description.buoy: Readings of wind, waves and water temperature from a buoy or coastal station. Each reading counts while it's fresh, and nudges the next few hours.
data_description.airport: Hourly reports of wind, visibility and air temperature. If there's a choice, pick one near the water.

sensors.name: Your own sensors
sensors.description: Readings from your own weather station or a boat's instruments come first, ahead of the buoy and airport. SailCast takes them to be at the spot.

error.name_taken: Another spot already has this name.
error.radius_out_of_range: Make the circle's radius between 2 and 50 km (about 1 to 30 miles).
error.suggestions_unavailable: Couldn't look up nearby sources. You can save without them and add them later by editing the spot.
error.fetch_out_of_range: Make the open water between 0.05 and 100 km (about 0.03 to 60 miles).
error.invalid_sensor: Pick a sensor for each reading, or leave it empty.

data_description.name: For example, the boat's name.
data_description.size_class: Each size has its own safety limits for wind, gusts and waves.
data_description.lights: Turn on if the boat has working navigation lights. Hours after dark then count too, within the sailor's times.

data_description.name: For example, the boat's name.
data_description.size_class: Each size has its own safety limits for wind, gusts and waves.
data_description.lights: Turn on if the boat has working navigation lights. Hours after dark then count too, within the sailor's times.

error.name_taken: Another boat already has this name.
error.length_out_of_range: Enter a length between 1 and 50 m (3 and 164 ft).

data_description.skill: Each sailor rates their own skill. It sets their limit for sustained wind; gusts don't count toward it.
data_description.default_boat: SailCast rates this boat unless the sailor picks another.
data_description.other_boats: Other boats this sailor takes out.
data_description.user: The panel opens on this sailor for them.

hours.name: Hours each day
hours.description: For the sailing days above. Leave a time empty to start at sunrise or finish at sunset, or for any hour in a boat with navigation lights. One day, such as a day off, can be changed in the SailCast panel.

comfort.name: Comfort
comfort.description: What this sailor enjoys. These change scores, never a safety rating.

data_description.ideal_low: Narrows the ideal wind for each of their boats. Leave empty to use the boat's range.
data_description.ideal_high: Leave empty to use the boat's range, up to the skill limit.
data_description.coldest: Scores drop in colder air. Leave empty for 50 °F (10 °C).

auto_calendar.name: Automatic calendar
auto_calendar.description: Add this sailor's best window each chosen day to a calendar, at most one event a day. SailCast keeps the event in step with the forecast until 6 PM the evening before, then warns instead of moving it.

data_description.calendar: Leave empty to turn automatic adding off. Local Calendar, Google Calendar and CalDAV calendars accept new events.
data_description.ahead: Forecasts change most beyond three days.
data_description.auto_spots: When windows at different spots overlap, SailCast adds only the best one.

error.name_taken: Another sailor already has this name.
error.unknown_boat: That boat has been removed. Pick another.
error.end_before_start: The latest finish has to be after the earliest start.
error.ideal_high_below_low: The top of the range has to be above the bottom.
error.calendar_read_only: That calendar can't take new events. Pick a Local Calendar, Google Calendar or CalDAV calendar.

abort.no_boats: Add a boat first. Every sailor needs at least one.

options.dinghy: Dinghy or beach cat, up to about 16 ft (5 m)
options.large_cruiser: Large cruiser, 35 ft (10.5 m) and up

options.beginner: Beginner: up to 10 kt of sustained wind
options.advanced: Advanced: no wind limit, just guidance

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Gets a sailor's safety ratings, scores and sailing windows at a spot, for each day and each hour from now.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.description: The sailor's name. Ratings use their skill level.

boat.name: Boat
boat.description: One of the sailor's boats. Leave empty for all of them.

pin_on_land.title: {spot}'s pin is on land
pin_on_land.description: SailCast works out {spot}'s waves and fetch from where its pin is, and the map puts the pin on land. Open SailCast, go to Settings, edit {spot}, and drag the pin onto the water where you sail.

quiet_buoy.title: Buoy {station} has gone quiet
quiet_buoy.description: Buoy {station} hasn't sent a reading for 12 hours, so SailCast uses the forecast alone for {spots}. Buoys go quiet for repairs and in storms. If it stays quiet, edit {spots} in SailCast's settings and pick another buoy, or none.

quiet_airport.title: Airport {station} has gone quiet
quiet_airport.description: Airport {station} hasn't sent a weather report for 12 hours, so SailCast uses the forecast alone for {spots}. If it stays quiet, edit {spots} in SailCast's settings and pick another airport, or none.

quiet_sensor.title: Sensor {sensor} has gone quiet
quiet_sensor.description: {sensor} hasn't reported for 12 hours, so SailCast uses other readings or the forecast for {spots}. Check the sensor, or take it out of {spots} in SailCast's settings.

failing_tide.title: Tide predictions for {station} aren't coming
failing_tide.description: {provider} hasn't returned tide predictions for {station} for a day. SailCast uses the predictions it saved earlier for {spots} while they still cover the week. If it keeps failing, edit {spots} in SailCast's settings and pick another tide source.

failing_current.title: Current station {station} isn't answering
failing_current.description: {provider} hasn't returned predictions for current station {station} for a day. SailCast uses the predictions it saved earlier for {spots} while they still cover the week. If it keeps failing, edit {spots} in SailCast's settings and pick another station, or none.

budget_low.title: Open-Meteo's free calls are running low
budget_low.description: SailCast has used {calls} of Open-Meteo's 10,000 free calls today, so it now updates the forecast every three hours instead of every hour, and the wind map rests until tomorrow. Anything else on the same internet connection shares the allowance. The count starts again at midnight UTC.

worldtides_key_missing.title: WorldTides needs a key
worldtides_key_missing.description: SailCast gets the tides for {spots} from WorldTides, but has no WorldTides key. Add your key in SailCast's options (Settings → Devices & services → SailCast → Configure), or edit {spots} in SailCast's settings and pick another tide source.

worldtides_key_rejected.title: WorldTides refused SailCast's key
worldtides_key_rejected.description: WorldTides answered: "{error}". Check the key in SailCast's options (Settings → Devices & services → SailCast → Configure) and your account's credits at worldtides.info. Until then, SailCast uses the tide predictions it saved for {spots} while they last.

keys.name: API keys
keys.description: Keys for providers that need one. They stay in Home Assistant and never reach the panel.

data_description.worldtides_key: Tide predictions anywhere, from worldtides.info, with your own account. A spot that uses it costs about 3 credits every five days. Leave empty to remove the key.

ai.name: AI briefing
ai.description: Adds a briefing to the panel, written by the AI provider you've set up in Home Assistant: the best times to sail this week across your spots and boats, and a note for each day. Safety ratings always come from SailCast's own rules, never from AI.

data_description.ai_task: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's default, set under Settings → System → AI.

error.no_ai_task: Set up an AI provider in Home Assistant first. Its integration adds the AI task SailCast uses.
error.no_default_ai_task: Pick an AI task, or set a default one under Settings → System → AI.

common.advisory: SailCast is advisory: check the latest forecast and official warnings before you go.
common.forecast_for: SailCast forecast for {sailor} in the {boat}, made {date} at {time}.
common.check_again: SailCast is advisory: check the forecast and official warnings again before you go.
common.changed: The forecast for {sailor}'s sail at {spot} on {date}, {start} to {end}, has got worse. It's now {level}, score {score}. Check SailCast before you go.
